description: Source code for string data type operations in pandas-on-Spark, including methods for string addition, multiplication, comparison, and type casting, specifically for StringType in Spark.

classes.name: StringOps
classes.description: Class for binary string operations on pandas-on-Spark objects with Spark StringType.

classes.name: StringExtensionOps
classes.description: Subclass of StringOps for objects with StringType and StringDtype, includes restore method.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Concatenates string columns or appends a string to a string column.

methods.name: mul
methods.description: Repeats string columns a specified number of times.

methods.name: radd
methods.description: Concatenates a string to the beginning of a string column.

methods.name: rmul
methods.description: Repeats string columns a specified number of times (right multiplication).

methods.name: lt
methods.description: Performs less-than comparison between string columns and other values.

methods.name: astype
methods.description: Casts string columns to specified data types, handling StringType and BooleanType.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores pandas Series from pandas-on-Spark column, converting to dtype.
